title: Mailing a Package at the Post Office
context: Nina 第一次去邮局给国外的朋友寄生日礼物，向柜员 Owen 询问包装要求、运输方式和运费。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to mail this package to a friend in Canada.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想把这个包裹寄给加拿大的一位朋友。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Sure. Is there anything fragile or liquid inside?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。里面有易碎品或者液体吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Just a small ceramic mug and a card. No liquids.
dialogue.zh: 只有一个小陶瓷杯子和一张卡片。没有液体。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Okay. Wrap the mug in bubble wrap, then seal the box with packing tape.
dialogue.zh: 好。请先用气泡膜包好杯子，再用胶带把箱子封好。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Got it. How long will regular shipping take?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。普通邮寄大概要多久？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: About seven to ten business days. Express usually takes three to five.
dialogue.zh: 大概七到十个工作日。快递一般三到五天。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I'll take regular shipping. Do I need to fill out a customs form?
dialogue.zh: 我选普通邮寄。需要填海关申报单吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Yes. Write the contents and approximate value on this form.
dialogue.zh: 需要。在这张表格上写明物品内容和大概价值。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Okay. How much will it cost for this size?
dialogue.zh: 好。这个尺寸大概要多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Eighteen dollars, including tracking. Would you like insurance as well?
dialogue.zh: 十八美元，含物流追踪。要不要顺便加保险？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Yes, please add basic insurance. Can I pay by card?
dialogue.zh: 好，请加基础保险。可以刷卡吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Of course. Here's your receipt and tracking number. Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。这是您的收据和运单号。祝您今天愉快！

expressions.en: I'd like to mail this package
expressions.zh: 我想寄这个包裹。邮局、快递柜常用开场。
expressions.example: I'd like to mail this package overseas.

expressions.zh: 里面有易碎品吗？柜员核对寄件内容时常用。
expressions.example: Is there anything fragile or liquid inside?

expressions.zh: 工作日。说时效时通常不含周末。
expressions.example: It takes seven to ten business days.

expressions.zh: 填写海关申报单。国际寄件必备。
expressions.example: You'll need to fill out a customs form.

expressions.zh: 运单号/物流追踪号。查询包裹进度用。
expressions.example: Keep your tracking number to check the delivery.

pronunciation: 练习 package 的重音在 PAC。注意 customs form 连读时 form 清晰送气，business days 里 business 的弱读 /ˈbɪznəs/，以及 tracking number 的节奏：TRACKing NUMber。

practice.title: Part 1 · Letters and packages
practice.prompt: Do you often send letters or packages?
practice.answer: Not very often. I mostly send packages for birthdays or holidays. For everyday messages, I just use my phone.

practice.title: Part 2 · A time you sent something
practice.prompt: Describe a time you sent a letter or a package. Say what you sent, where it went, and how you felt about it.
practice.answer: Last year I mailed a birthday gift to my friend in Canada. I packed a mug carefully and chose regular shipping. I felt happy when she received it safely. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Online shopping and delivery
practice.prompt: How has online shopping changed the way people send and receive packages?
practice.answer: Online shopping has made delivery much more common. People expect fast shipping and tracking. On the other hand, more packages also mean more packaging waste and busy post offices.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习说明包裹里有什么、选哪种运输，以及是否需要保险。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么寄一个国际包裹：内容、包装、运输方式和付款。
